verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an Uptime API covering monitor CRUD endpoints, plus an MCP server limited to telemetry such as logs, metrics, traces and errors. Incident acknowledge and resolve actions are documented only through Slack, phone and the dashboard. No documented API endpoint or MCP tool lets an agent acknowledge, escalate or resolve incidents programmatically, so the capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can acknowledge, escalate, and resolve incidents end to end through a documented API or MCP connection — no dashboard in the loop
